hooks.command: git fetch --all -q 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null || echo ?); echo "[samgongyuk auto-check] new commits on GitHub not pulled yet: $n (see CLAUDE.md: report them to the user in Korean, then merge before any work)"; git log --oneline --format='  %h %an %ad %s' --date=format:'%m-%d %H:%M' HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null | head -20; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -10
